spot.name: Coromandel
spot.notes: Eastern seaboard classic. Excellent boat and kayak fishing.
spot.facing_note: Centre point sits on the Firth of Thames (west) side

verdict.headline: Go Tue 5-8am
verdict.advice: Tue 5-8am, light cross-offshore NE 4 kn, 0.2 m sea @ 4 s, falling tide, low 8:12am, dawn - try snapper: soft-baits or berleyed baits along reef edges and work-ups

species.name: Snapper
species.how: soft-baits or berleyed baits along reef edges and work-ups
notes: Inshore spawning aggregations Oct-Mar, peak Nov-Dec; spawning starts at roughly 14.8-16 C sea temperature.
sources: Parsons et al. 2014, 'Snapper (Chrysophrys auratus): a review of life history and key vulnerabilities in New Zealand', NZ J Marine & Freshwater Research 48(2). https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/00288330.2014.892013
